author: Gould, 1845
habitat: 도시와 농촌의 평지, 마을 주변 나무와 농경지

months.note: 전국에 사는 텃새다. 2월부터 번식을 시작하며, 서울대학교 캠퍼스 장기 조사에서는 3월 초부터 6월 중순까지 둥지의 알과 새끼를 조사한다.

summary: 푸른 광택이 도는 검은 몸에 흰 배와 흰 어깨 무늬, 긴 꼬리를 가진 까마귀과 새로, 우리나라를 대표하는 텃새다. 도시와 농촌의 평지에 살며 나무나 전신주 위에 둥지를 튼다. 이른 봄인 2월부터 번식을 시작하고, 번식기가 지나면 무리를 지어 지낸다. 예전에는 유라시아까치(Pica pica)의 한 아종으로 보았으나 유전자 연구 이후 별개의 종으로 나뉘었다.
young: 어린새는 어른새와 무늬가 같지만 검은 부분이 광택 없는 그을음색이고 흰 부분에 담황색 기가 돈다. 꼬리가 어른새보다 짧으며, 늦여름이면 어른새와 거의 같아진다.

similar.how: 몸길이 37cm로 작고, 검은 머리 아래 몸이 회갈색이며 날개와 꼬리가 하늘색이다. 흰 어깨 무늬와 흰 배가 없다.

art.subject: Oriental Magpie (Pica serica), adult (sexes alike) in late winter: head, neck, breast, mantle and back black with a faint blue-green gloss; a large pure white patch on each shoulder (the scapulars); belly and flanks white, sharply divided from the black breast; wings black with a strong blue-green gloss on the secondaries and tertials; primaries black with extensive white inner webs, showing as a white panel when the wing opens; vent and undertail black; very long graduated tail, black glossed green with a purple and bronze sheen; black bill; dark brown eye; black legs.
art.pose: perched upright on a bare branch near the top of a tall tree, tail angled down, head in side profile
art.scene: Korean rural lowland in late winter (February): bare deciduous trees such as zelkova and poplar with a large nest high in the branches, harvested rice paddies and a frosty field edge in the background; no people, buildings, utility poles or text
views: adult, perched on a branch, side view: black head, breast and back, white shoulder patch, clean white belly and flanks, glossy black wings, very long graduated glossy tail angled down

adult in flight seen from above, head, body and tail in line: black back with a white scapular patch along each side, rounded black wings with large white panels on the primaries edged and tipped black, long graduated tail
adult in flight seen from below, head, body and tail in line: black head and breast, white belly, black vent, white primaries with black tips and outer edges, long black tail
art.build: Large black-and-white member of the crow family, 46cm, of which about half is tail; the body is about the size of a feral pigeon. Rounded head, short neck. Bill black, stout and slightly arched, a little shorter than the head. Legs fairly long, black; walks and hops on the ground. Wings short and rounded; at rest they reach only the base of the tail. Tail very long and strongly graduated, the central feathers longest, often raised and flicked. Flies with quick fluttering beats of rounded wings, showing white panels in the primaries.
avoid: Do not paint blue wings and tail, a black cap and a grey body; that is Azure-winged Magpie.
Do not paint a short tail; the tail is about half the bird's length.
Do not paint a white back; the back is black and the white is on the shoulders and belly only.
Do not paint the tail matt black; it shows green and purple gloss.
